member.name: M:Windows.Win32.PInvoke.SHAddToRecentDocs(System.UInt32,System.Void*)
member.summary: Notifies the system that an item has been accessed, for the purposes of tracking those items used most recently and most frequently. This function can also be used to clear all usage data.

param.name: uFlags
param.para: Type: UINT A value from the SHARD enumeration that indicates the form of the information pointed to by the pv parameter.

param.name: pv
param.para: Type: LPCVOID A pointer to data that identifies the item that has been accessed. The item can be specified in this parameter in one of the following forms:

remarks.para: The usage statistics gathered through calls to this method are used to determine lists of items accessed most recently and most frequently. These lists are seen in the Start menu and, in Windows 7 and later, in an application's Jump List. When this method is called, it affects the following areas:

member.name: T:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD
member.summary: Indicates the interpretation of the data passed by SHAddToRecentDocs in its pv parameter to identify the item whose usage statistics are being tracked.

remarks.para: Before Windows 7, SHARD_PIDL, SHARD_PATHA, and SHARD_PATHW were defined as individual constants, not as enumeration members. When providing an IShellLink through either SHARD_LINK or SHARD_APPIDINFOLINK, the IShellLink instance must provide the following:

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_PIDL
member.summary: The pv parameter points to a PIDL that identifies the document's file object. PIDLs that identify non-file objects are not accepted.

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_PATHA
member.summary: The pv parameter points to a null-terminated ANSI string with the path and file name of the object.

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_PATHW
member.summary: The pv parameter points to a null-terminated Unicode string with the path and file name of the object.

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_APPIDINFO
member.summary: Windows 7 and later. The pv parameter points to a SHARDAPPIDINFO structure that pairs an IShellItem that identifies the item with an AppUserModelID that associates it with a particular process or application.

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_APPIDINFOIDLIST
member.summary: Windows 7 and later. The pv parameter points to a SHARDAPPIDINFOIDLIST structure that pairs an absolute PIDL that identifies the item with an AppUserModelID that associates it with a particular process or application.

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_LINK
member.summary: Windows 7 and later. The pv parameter is an interface pointer to an IShellLink object.

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_APPIDINFOLINK
member.summary: Windows 7 and later. The pv parameter points to a SHARDAPPIDINFOLINK structure that pairs an IShellLink that identifies the item with an AppUserModelID that associates it with a particular process or application.

member.name: F:Windows.Win32.UI.Shell.SHARD.SHARD_SHELLITEM
member.summary: Windows 7 and later. The pv parameter is an interface pointer to an IShellItem object.
